Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #411 as item 1 of 3 (two new cards and one re-ruling). Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `500bc9d5`; the card is not restated):
- Premises hold: `packages/services/service-print/src/print-service.ts:339–363` still refuses any page that is not the object's default record page; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:280` exports `RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE = ':objectName/record/:recordId/page/:pageName'` and mounts it at :1449 — the console half the #23811 PR body named as missing has shipped (in 18.2.0). Precedent for the workload column: PR #23811 built the whole service, +4074/−68 over 44 files; A is one check, one URL and tests.
- Platform-first reading: this is a platform door the app waits on (the maintainer chose 「等平台支持打印指定页」 over an app-side workaround) — the app-repo rule is satisfied by filing here.
- Half-state: `needs-user-decision` alone, no pm-state, no `domain:*`; the ruling's stroke queues it in `domain:server`.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① A keeps print pages and working pages distinct and reuses a shipped route, no key; ② hotcrm #2312 is built, measured and blocked today; ③ A stays a loud refusal (not a record page of the object, or no `print`); ④ B pushes the cost onto every printing app, C reopens 8346 B′.
- The seat agrees with **A**. Not B (every app that prints gives up the record's working page) and not C (the screen is the paper; reopens the printable-subset ruling). Workload: server · 1 PR · S (unmeasured; the precedent is the whole service).
Prior rulings read: 8346 B′ (printable subset), #22158 / #22269 / #22270 / #23985, objectui#12715; ADR none; thread: the HotCRM project thread.

Ruling: batch #411 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「26583 A 25870 A」 2026-10-27T10:19Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #411 with 「26583 A 25870 A」. Brief 6439129875. Letter **A**: `service-print` prints a record on any record page of its object that declares `print`, rendering the console's named record-page route (`…/record/ID/page/PAGE`, `RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE`) when `req.page` is not the default; the record route stays for the default page. `refuseUnlessPrintPage` narrows to two loud refusals — the page is not a record page of this object, or it declares no `print`. `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` (en and translations) loses the "a print page that is not the default is refused" sentence; a dogfood print of a non-default page pins the new door. Not B (every printing app gives up its working page) and not C (reopens ruling 8346 B′'s printable subset). No spec key changes: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Workload (card column): `domain:server` · 1 PR · S (one check, one URL, tests, docs); precedent PR #23811 built the whole service (+4074/−68). hotcrm #2312 unblocks on the npm release that carries it; the `repo:hotcrm` seat lands #2312 then.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act, `domain:server` added (the card names the reader); priority is triage's on first grade. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment.

## Triage: first grade — `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `domain:server` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-27T10:56Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **p1:** a print-page capability ruled A (6439306670). If it adds an authorable key (which page a record prints on), it is a protocol addition. Under #26368 ruling A, every protocol addition is p1, app-driven or not. Handled directly in 18.x. Skills, docs and eval are owed (#26369 B). If the PR measures that no key is added, it is p2, and the PR says so.
- **Lane:** `service-print` is `domain:server`. The schema key, if any, falls under the server fence (a spec seat signs off, or it splits).
